purpose: Test whether identical visible labels can identify the same physical site across constructed possible worlds.
limitations: All site identifiers and site relationships are invented for this counterexample; they are not reports about actual students or hospitals.
Hypothetical site identifiers belong to the evaluation oracle and are never supplied to the text comparison functions.
The worlds were constructed after the functions existed; this is not preregistration, an independent holdout set or field validation.
No prevalence, empirical accuracy, error-rate estimate or student-authored counterexample is established.
